name: mc_protect
title: Protected regions
description:
Adds, lists and removes protected regions: named, persistent boxes that mc_build, mc_repair and mc_restore refuse to write into (mode "deny") or only warn about (mode "warn") unless a call names the region in `override`.

WHEN TO USE: the user wants an area kept safe from later agent edits ("don't touch the dock", "this module is approved"); before working near one, list regions with `touches`.
WHEN NOT TO USE: as griefing protection (players, other plugins and mc_command are not checked), or to undo changes (mc_restore). Do not remove a region or use override just to get a rejected build through; ask the user.

PARAMETERS: add: name (1-64 lowercase letters, digits, '-', '_'; unique), from/to, optional world, note (at most 200 characters) and mode (default deny). list: optional world and touches. remove: name; only its creator, an operator or the console/MCP token may remove it.

SIDE EFFECTS: add/remove rewrite plugins/Ashlar/protected.json; no world changes. A deny overlap rejects the writing call before any write and names the region, overlapping cells and bounds; mc_plan and dryRun only report it. Overrides are logged. Checks cover write targets, not physics or connection updates outside them.

name.description: Region name; required for add and remove.

world.description: add/list: world name; defaults to the server's default world.

mode.description: add: deny rejects writing calls; warn lets them write with a warning.

note.description: add: why the area is protected; shown in rejections and warnings.

touches.description: list: only regions intersecting this box.
